description: This file defines a Java interface for persistence operations used by the 'Things Search Updater' service within the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies methods for retrieving policy reference tags and outdated thing IDs using reactive streams (Akka Streams).

classes.name: ThingsSearchUpdaterPersistence
classes.description: A Java interface for persistence operations related to the search updater service, providing methods to fetch policy reference tags and outdated thing IDs using reactive streams.

methods.name: getPolicyReferenceTags
methods.description: Retrieves a stream of policy reference tags that match the given policy revisions, returning a Source publisher for reactive processing.

methods.name: getOutdatedThingIds
methods.description: Retrieves a stream of Thing IDs associated with a policy tag that are outdated, returning a Source publisher for reactive processing.
